loop: CANDIDATE -> TECHNICAL DIAGNOSIS (limiting variable + direction) -> TECHNICAL MUTATION (actual design variable) -> INDEPENDENT TECHNICAL EVALUATION -> EVIDENCE/PRIOR-ART RECHECK -> KEEP/KILL -> SECOND IMPROVEMENT

MAX_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT.justification: the CEO milestone is DIAGNOSE -> TECHNICAL MUTATION -> RE-EVALUATE -> SECOND IMPROVEMENT; two iterations demonstrate repeatability at bounded cost

MAX_PROPOSALS_PER_ITERATION.justification: bounded proposal budget, identical to the R378 epistemic loop: three attempts, then the honest no-defensible-mutation verdict

VALUE_CLASS_STRICTNESS.justification: EXTRACTED claims are span-verified or rejected (Art. II/VI); MODELLED values are admitted only when declared; an unbounded parameter is immutable (ADR_R379 anti-gaming)

mutation_kinds_reserved.ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE: needs a structural/control search space at a higher fidelity tier (ADR_R379)
mutation_kinds_reserved.CONTROL_POLICY_CHANGE: needs a structural/control search space at a higher fidelity tier (ADR_R379)

keep_criterion: the child's OWN independent technical evaluation must confirm the objective improves in the mutation direction with constraints preserved — a score increase is NEVER sufficient (CEO R379 item 4/8)
outcome_reason: improving directions exist but no movable DESIGN variable (outcomes are not set directly; unbounded parameters are immutable — ADR_R379)

parameters.name: stress distribution
parameters.role: mechanical load distribution across the prosthesis

parameters.name: stress concentration
parameters.role: localized points of high mechanical stress that can lead to detachment

parameters.name: detachment force
parameters.role: force required to detach prosthesis components

parameters.name: flexibility
parameters.role: ability of the prosthesis to bend naturally with movement

parameters.name: material strength
parameters.role: resistance of the prosthesis material to deformation under load

parameters.name: CFRP content
parameters.role: percentage of carbon fiber reinforced polymer in the reinforced components

parameters.name: load bearing capacity
parameters.role: maximum load the prosthesis can support without failure

parameters.name: operating force
parameters.role: forces experienced by the prosthesis during normal use

parameters.name: body weight
parameters.role: weight of the patient using the prosthesis

constraints.justification: minimum force required to prevent detachment under normal use
must maintain natural knee movement without compromising structural integrity
maximum allowable stress concentration to prevent component detachment

objectives.basis: increase resistance to component detachment to prevent device failure
reduce localized stress points that lead to component detachment
maintain natural knee movement while reinforcing structural components

failure_modes.name: component detachment
failure_modes.problem_link: detachment of device or device component

dependencies.statement: increasing carbon fiber reinforced polymer content increases material strength
higher material strength increases the force required for component detachment
increasing carbon fiber reinforced polymer content improves stress distribution
better stress distribution reduces localized stress concentration
higher body weight increases forces experienced by the prosthesis
higher operating forces increase the risk of component detachment

objective.basis: increase resistance to component detachment to prevent device failure

uncertainty.note: UNKNOWN values are never treated as zeros; unverifiable constraints are never treated as satisfied (Art. XXV / Art. IV)

conventions.name: ORDINAL_LEVERAGE_BY_PATH_LENGTH
conventions.justification: with MONOTONE-only relations the evaluator cannot rank leverage by magnitude; it ranks by (1) fewest constraint blocks, (2) shortest causal path from the parameter to the objective target, (3) envelope provenance class (EXTRACTED beats MODELLED). This is a declared ordinal convention, not a measurement — recorded on every evaluation that uses it.
conventions.uncertainty: ordinal only; magnitudes are UNKNOWN at this tier

conventions.name: DIRECTIONAL_FAIL_CLOSED
conventions.justification: a proposed change is constraint-BLOCKED when (a) the changed parameter's own numeric constraint would be violated at the proposed value, or (b) a relation-connected constraint target is already VIOLATED or value-UNKNOWN and the predicted direction moves it TOWARD its bound. Fail-closed on directional risk: an unknown-position target moving toward a bound is a blocked move, not an accepted one (Art. IV).
